settings.title: Burn & care
settings.text: Let the first burn reach the edge of the jar (about two hours). Trim the wick to 5 mm before each light. Stop when 1 cm of wax is left.

settings.title: What it is made of
settings.text: Coconut and rapeseed wax, a cotton wick and fine fragrance, poured into a reusable glass jar. Vegan, no paraffin.

settings.title: Delivery & returns
settings.text: Dispatched in 2 working days. Free UK delivery over £50, otherwise £3.95. Unlit candles can be returned within 30 days.
